title: SAE-Xplainers: Rule-Based Feature Interpretation for Extreme Earth Events
abstract: arXiv:2608.20117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The emergence of large-scale Weather and Climate (W&C) datasets offers new opportunities for modeling extreme Earth events (ExEE) and their impacts using deep learning. However, their adoption in operational settings remains limited by the lack of models' interpretability. While for conventional text and image modalities, tools such as Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have proven effective for extracting human-understandable concepts, their use for the analysis of ExEE remains challenging due to the nature of W&C data. translated_title: SAE-Xplainers：极端地球事件的基于规则的特征解释
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20117v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大规模天气与气候（W&C）数据集的涌现为利用深度学习建模极端地球事件（ExEE）及其影响提供了新机遇。然而，由于模型可解释性的缺乏，其在操作环境中的应用仍受到限制。对于传统的文本和图像模态，稀疏自编码器（SAEs）等工具已被证明能有效提取人类可理解的概念，但由于W&C数据的特性，将其用于ExEE分析仍具挑战性。为解决此问题，我们引入了（i）基于地理位置的输入调制方法，用于SAE以捕捉环境模式的局部语义，以及（ii）一组基于规则的SAE-Xplainers集成，用于解释从复杂、多模态环境预测因子中得出的高维特征。我们在三种ExEE类型上评估了我们的方法：火灾预测、热带气旋检测和（此处原文截断，可能为其他极端事件）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合地理位置调制的稀疏自编码器和基于规则的解释器集成方法，用于提升极端地球事件深度学习模型的可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a method combining geographic location-based modulation of sparse autoencoders with an ensemble of rule-based explainers to enhance interpretability of deep learning models for extreme Earth events.
